A member of your party has left.
Accelerating charge with high knockback and damage.
All wireless controllers (not including Joy-Cons) will be treated as USB GameCube controllers. Use this setting if your wireless controllers have both ZL and ZR buttons.
Ball of fire that deals moderate damage and knockback.
Boomerang that tries to return to the caster. Collisions with other units cause the boomerang to grow in size.
Caster leaps high into the air and detonates your Crystals upon landing, dealing heavy damage, creating platforms, and immobilizing units within range.

Casts a Crystal into the air that deals damage upon landing. Cast distance is determined by spell curve. Upon reactivation, the Crystal is reeled in. On cast, your Crystals become Hooked, attaching themselves on contact.
CHOOSE A SIDE FOR TEAMS OR STAY IN CENTER FOR FFA
Compete for game keys, gems, and XP in official monthly MageQuit tournaments.

Compete in community organized events.
More info at magequit.com/league
Conjures a jet of water that pushes the caster backward and enemies away.
Conjures a pyre that damages wizards and grows as it incinerates other spells.
Creates a bubble around the caster that prevents one instance of damage and heals for that amount instead.
Creates a growing wave that slows and carries your enemies away.
Creates a protective gale around the caster that redirects spells forward.
Creates a rock wall in front of the caster to block wizards and spells.
Creates a static field that prevents half of the damage taken. After 4 seconds, the field discharges, dealing full damage back to each source.
Creates a vacuum around a target, pulling in wizards and spells.
Disk that, on contact, summons a clone that mimics your movement and explodes if killed. Can be reactivated to swap positions with clone.
Encases a target in 3 stone walls that accelerate toward the caster.
Extra-long dash that chains up to 7 nearby units when successfully hit, pulling all affected units to starting point of dash.
Fast melee attack with high knockback. If missed, the caster falls over.
Fires a barrage of 5 icicles in the cast direction, dealing damage and creating new Crystals after a delay. On cast, your Crystals become Inert, just sitting there.
First Full Game of the Day
Flask that explodes on contact, creating a cloud that hurts enemies and heals allies over time.
Frog that jumps 3 times, healing and bouncing all nearby wizards. Enemies only receive half healing.
Glass shard with a high cooldown that refreshes if a unit is hit.
Go head to head, starting with all 7 spells.

Go head to head, starting with all 7 spells.
This queue opens at 9pm EST each night.
Gust of wind that deals minor damage and knockback. Lowest cast time and longest range.
Hammer that forces target wizard to cast the same spell type (e.g. melee, secondary) that the caster used previously, regardless of cooldown.
Heavy rock that deals moderate damage and high knockback. Highest cast time.
Hose that attaches on impact. Can be reactivated to swap positions with attached unit. Curving the reactivation will apply force.
Hourglass that attaches to a unit and detonates with upward force after 3 seconds.
Hurls a capacitor that attaches itself to a unit and explodes when it comes into contact with another unit.
Hurls a device that teleports you and creates 2 clones to surround your enemy. Clones mimic your spell casts and movement and explode if killed.
Hurls a snowball that becomes more deadly the further it travels and forms a Crystal on impact. On cast, your Crystals become Brittle, exploding on enemy contact.
Invokes a large boulder that petrifies units and creates walls in its wake.
Learn the basics of movement, spell casting, spell curving, and drafting.
Leech that attaches itself to an enemy, dealing damage over time. If collected, it heals based on the damage done.
Less chance. More sweat. Ideal for tournaments and ranked play.
Life preserver that absorbs one hit and creates a clone in your place, teleporting you behind the damaging wizard. Clones mimic your movement and explode if killed. Reactivate to swap with clone.
Lightning bolt that deals high damage and very high knockback. High cast time.
Lightning bug that pulls in the nearest unit within its range. After 2 pulls, the bug explodes, launching nearby units upward.
Melee attack that briefly turns nearby enemies to stone. If missed, the caster falls over.
Melee attack that deals more damage and knockback the farther the caster travels between swings. If missed, the caster falls over.
Melee attack that forms a Crystal on impact. If missed, caster falls over. On cast, your Crystals become Cold, slowing and damaging nearby enemy units over time.
Melee attack that imprisons units in a tree, preventing all damage and spellcasting. Tree will fall away from its caster. If missed, the caster falls over.
Melee attack that increases damage and knockback with each successful hit. If missed, the caster falls over and is launched backwards.
Melee attack that launches nearby units into the air. If missed, the caster falls over.
Melee attack that rewinds the position of affected wizards. Damage is dealt based on distance from position when initially hit. If missed, the caster falls over.
Melee attack that shackles a unit to a ball and chain. If missed, the caster falls over.
Melee attack with low knockback that deals damage over time. If missed, the caster falls over.
Metal star that can bounce to a nearby second target. Can hit caster-owned units.
Play a 3v3 team game with some extra objectives.

Play a 3v3 team game with some extra objectives.
This queue is still under development.
Play a 4v4 or 5v5 team game with extra objectives.
Play with 5 other wizards in a free for all battle.
Play with friends for extra XP
Please update MageQuit to play online.
Returns your wizard to their current location and health after 3 seconds, dealing damage and knockback along the way.
Rock golem that summons on contact and chases after the unit it hit last.
Rocket that accelerates through units, increasing its damage and knockback with each hit.
Sea urchin that attaches itself to a unit. After 4 seconds, it latches to the next nearest unit, pulling it and the attached unit together, dealing damage on collision.
SELECT MORE MODES FOR SHORTER QUEUE TIMES
Shield that grows as it absorbs spells, then explodes forward with proportional damage and knockback.
Short dash that can be reactivated for a very long dash that pulls contacted units with it.
Short dash that can be reactivated to jump, dealing damage upon landing.
Short leap that deals high damage in front of caster upon landing.
Short leap that leaves behind a trap which can steal control of a non-player unit if caught. Can be reactivated to toss unit, dealing damage on impact.
Short range leash that when landed successfully will pull an enemy toward caster. If missed, the caster is pulled to the location.
Short range teleport that resets velocity and primary cooldown. Can be reactivated to return to casting point.
Small fireball that can be activated up to 4 times in a row. Cooldown increases with each activation.
Somer Assault can be casted twice to jump.
Spells are drafted one at a time after each round, starting with the wizard with the shortest beard.
Spells are drafted one at a time after each round, starting with the wizard with the shortest beard. Not ideal for 7+ players.
Summons a chameleon that copies the last spell casted by target wizard. That wizard is slowed and the caster becomes invisible briefly. Reactivate to cast the copied spell.

Summons a Crystal below the caster, launching them forward. On reactivation, the caster is pulled on a sled to their newest Crystal. On cast, your Crystals become Feral, following the nearest enemy unit.

Summons a Crystal that protects the caster until it’s destroyed or changes form. On cast, your Crystals become Cryogenic, preserving the first spell that damages them. Preserved spells can be picked up and used by the caster.

Summons a katana that stores all damage the caster deals for the next 5 seconds. The caster then jumps between all damaged units, dealing that damage a second time and applying the caster's melee spell.
Summons an orb of fire that launches a cone of fireballs. If hit with a spell, it can be destroyed.

Summons orbiting metal shields for 2 seconds. If damage would be taken, a shield is hurled at the source of that damage, chaining them to the caster and preventing all damage from that source for 5 seconds.
Summons puppet strings that delay all knockback and slow the target. All accumulated knockback is then released at once with a 30% bonus.

THIS DIAGRAM IS NOT ACCURATE AS
CONTROLS HAVE BEEN CUSTOMIZED
TIP:  Ice Crystals expire if you don't create a new one within 5 seconds.
TIP:  Non Joy-Con controllers can be mapped as GameCube or Pro Controllers in Settings.
TIP:  You can curve your spells with the triggers.
Torrent of water that deals minor damage and minor knockback, but slows enemies briefly.
Torrent of water that splits into 7 parts, each part dealing half damage.
Tosses a slow-moving, homing turtle armed with your melee spell.
Try disabling XInput under Settings if you can't connect more controllers.
Very thin, long range, fast moving skillshot with a huge area of effect and knockback.
Vine that links to a unit or obstacle. If reactivated, caster accelerates towards its target, dealing damage and knockback based on speed of impact.
Warning:  Leaving a ranked game counts as a 0-3 loss.
Win a match daily for extra XP & gems
Worm that teleports units and spells between its ends. Can be closed if reactivated.
